research_name: Prop/algo forums (r/algotrading, Elite Trader, Futures.io) verified backtests
topic: transparent replicable intraday edges for cheap bot-allowed 5K/10K prop accounts (FundedNext Stellar Instant)
result_summary: No forum thread (r/algotrading, Elite Trader, Futures.io) with full rules plus out-of-sample or broker-verified live results was found; the futures.io thread itself did not surface in search. Best-evidenced item is an open-source TradingView NQ 1-minute London-session liquidity-sweep script with stated rules, costs, and an admitted losing period, but it is in-sample only and has no broker statement.
name: NQ CISD London 2R (TradingView open-source script by Bystry1991) [uncertain]
instrument: CME_MINI:NQ1! (Nasdaq-100 E-mini), 1 contract; Maven MT5 US100 equivalence not verified [uncertain]
timeframe: 1-minute strategy tester (Bar Magnifier enabled); signals on intraday session structure
entry_rule: Liquidity sweep, then confirmed shift in price delivery, then strong displacement candle; entries only 09:00-10:00 Europe/Warsaw; at most one trade per London session. Exact thresholds for sweep, delivery shift, and displacement not given. [uncertain]
exit_rule: Initial stop-loss; take-profit at 2R (before costs); any open position closed at 12:00 Europe/Warsaw. Session exits can land below 2R.
stop_rule: Initial stop-loss stated but its distance in points or ATR multiple is not given. [uncertain]
holding_time: Intraday; maximum until 12:00 Europe/Warsaw. Average duration not reported. [uncertain]
trades_per_year: Not reported as annual; 124 closed trades in six months (about 250 per year if extrapolated, my calculation, not reported). [uncertain]
overnight_weekend: No. Positions closed by 12:00 Europe/Warsaw each day.
signal_window_definition: Fixed 09:00-10:00 Europe/Warsaw window, one trade per London session, exit 12:00 Warsaw. Timezone-based, so DST is handled by the zone database; the script's explicit DST treatment is not described. [uncertain]
sample_period: 1 May 2026 to 31 Oct 2026 (six months), default London configuration
out_of_sample: None. Page states the result is a selected historical research result, not an independently validated out-of-sample track record.
cost_assumption: $3 commission per contract per side; one tick slippage; one contract; 1% margin is a simulation assumption, not a verified broker requirement.
reported_metrics: 124 closed trades; win rate 42.74%; profit factor 1.45; net profit $12,651 on $10,000 initial capital; max equity drawdown $5,753. Expectancy not reported (about $102 per trade by division, my calculation).
third_party_replication: None found. Public script with visible source link; replication not reported.
decay_status: Not assessed; only one six-month in-sample window plus one earlier losing six-month test.
regime_split: Earlier six-month test lost $5,357 (dates, trade count, and win rate not given); page states profitability was not consistent across both periods.
data_source_requirement: NQ 1-minute OHLC with TradingView Bar Magnifier; roll and gap handling not described. Maven MT5 US100 feed equivalence not verified. [uncertain]
min_lot_fit_5k10k: Not computable: stop distance not published, so risk % per 0.01 lot cannot be derived. [uncertain]
fn_rule_fit: Intraday only (no overnight), no grid, HFT, or tick-scalp pattern; stop-loss present. News +-5 min rule not addressed; London 08:00-09:00 local window may coincide with UK/EU releases. [uncertain]
bot_policy_compliance: Pine script: runs as a TradingView strategy, not directly as an MT5 EA; porting and bot-permission status not verified. [uncertain]
event_overlap: London session 09:00-10:00 Warsaw (08:00-09:00 London) may overlap UK and EU morning releases; not checked against calendar.
overlap_with_existing: No overlap with Sweep (US100 Sweep alarm), Donchian XAU, or BTC 21-23 by design; overlaps conceptually with other NQ intraday models if run together.
rejected_catalog_hit: Not checked against elenenler catalog; run python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol liquidity sweep in the main session. [uncertain]
base_rate_check: Win rate 42.74% with 2R target: breakeven win rate is about 33%, so result is above breakeven before costs, but no baseline random-entry comparison given.
pitfall_risk: In-sample only; small six-month sample (124 trades, overlapping context); earlier losing test shows regime sensitivity; sweep and displacement thresholds undefined (post-hoc tuning risk); single symbol; no OOS or forward record.
